北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有霾，出门记得戴口罩，保护呼吸道哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is hazy, remember to wear a mask to protect your respiratory system!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪小雨，体感 20℃ 略凉，出门别忘带伞，注意保暖！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has light rain, feels a bit cool at 20℃. Don't forget your umbrella and stay warm!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，气温 26℃ 舒适。天气多变，注意添减衣物哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, a comfortable 26℃. Weather changes, so dress accordingly.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 30℃ 略热，湿度高，注意防暑和补水哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, feels a bit hot at 30℃ with high humidity. Stay cool and hydrated!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 30℃ 炎热，记得多喝水，防晒避暑哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels hot at 30℃. Remember to drink water, protect from sun and heat!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 23℃ 宜人，出门散步很不错，保持好心情。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, a pleasant 23℃. Great for a walk, keep a good mood!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 24℃ 舒适，湿度较大，注意防潮和通风。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, a comfortable 24℃ with high humidity. Mind the dampness and ventilate!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 23℃ 凉爽，风力轻柔，享受舒适的一天。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, a cool 23℃ with a gentle breeze. Enjoy a comfortable day!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 27℃ 略热，湿度高，多喝水，保持身体舒适。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels a bit hot at 27℃ with high humidity. Drink water, stay comfortable.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 22℃ 温和，湿度适中，记得保持心情愉悦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, a mild 22℃ with moderate humidity. Remember to stay happy!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，气温 28℃，体感闷热，及时补充水分，注意防暑。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, 28℃ and muggy. Replenish water promptly, stay cool!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，体感 22℃ 舒适，风力较大，出门注意防风保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy, a comfortable 22℃ with strong winds. Mind the wind and stay warm!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，体感 23℃ 舒适，风力较大，注意防晒和补水。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, a comfortable 23℃ with strong winds. Remember sun protection and hydration.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 18℃ 凉爽，早晚温差大，注意添衣哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, a cool 18℃. Large temperature difference morning/evening, dress warmly.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门中雨，气温 21℃，湿度高，雨势较大，出门务必带伞！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen has moderate rain, 21℃ with high humidity. Heavy rain, be sure to take an umbrella!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 13℃ 偏凉，风力较大，记得多穿衣物保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels cool at 13℃ with strong winds. Remember to dress warmly!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 8℃ 寒凉，风力较大，出门请务必做好保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels cold at 8℃ with strong winds. Be sure to dress very warmly!
